description_en: Queries the throttling rules that are being executed or have been triggered

kebab_example: aliyun das get-sql-concurrency-control-rules-history --console-context None --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSqlConcurrencyControlRulesHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances and PolarDB for MySQL clusters are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和 PolarDB MySQL版实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
